day_shape: 83 items: IDF strike on Nasser Hospital in Khan Yunis kills six and targets Hamas Khan Younis brigade commander, two Iranians convicted in London of spying on Iran International, Tehran threatens US bases in Europe and Strait of Hormuz navigation, one OFAC SDN notice, heavy Khamenei Fatimid mourning cycle.

threads.label: IDF strike on Nasser Hospital, Khan Yunis
threads.summary: The IDF and Shin Bet said an overnight strike on the Nasser Hospital complex in Khan Yunis targeted Hamas's Khan Younis Brigade commander Muhammad Abu Ismail and other operatives. Hamas authorities reported six killed and over 20 wounded, including a doctor and a child; a separate strike hit a vehicle outside Shifa Hospital.

threads.label: Iran threats against US bases and Trump
threads.summary: Iranian Security Chief Mohsen Rezaei and IRGC commanders threatened to strike US bases in Europe and on distant islands if attacks resume, and pledged to kill US and Israeli leaders. Trump said at Arlington the war would end soon but insisted on "total victory"; Qatar is reportedly mediating.

threads.label: Iran-linked espionage and attack networks in Europe
threads.summary: Two Iranian men were convicted at London's Woolwich Crown Court of assisting Iranian intelligence operations targeting Iran International journalists in Britain. ITV News reported a seven-man Iran-linked network coordinated attacks across Europe using local criminals and AI-generated propaganda, following France's attribution of refrigeration-system cyberattacks to the IRGC.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and US economic pressure
threads.summary: CENTCOM said US forces continue enforcing a naval blockade against Iran and preventing IRGC use of land and Caspian routes; sources said Iran attacked ship navigation systems on Oman's Didamar island. OFAC published a new SDN designation notice, and Iran International reported rising Iranian transport and insurance costs from US land-route restrictions.

threads.label: Israeli cabinet and renewed Iran strikes planning
threads.summary: Israel's security cabinet is set to meet Sunday for the first time in six weeks amid IDF preparations for possible renewed strikes on Iran. A Jerusalem Post intelligence estimate put Iran's ballistic missile production at roughly 50 per month despite war damage, and Jpost explainers covered Netanyahu's caretaker powers and new US Congress options.

threads.label: Khamenei Fatimid mourning cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted extensive audio, video and photo coverage of the second night of Fatimid mourning ceremonies at Zaynabiyyah, led by the Supreme Leader with eulogies from Saeed Haddadian, Hanif Taheri and Ali Alizadeh. IRIB and Defa Press carried parallel coverage including a funeral for 110 unnamed martyrs scheduled for Friday at Tehran University.

threads.label: Iran domestic and diplomatic flashpoints
threads.summary: Iran International reported Parsian Bank is managed by Khamenei's Setad business empire, and that security agencies threatened to label slain-protester families "terrorists"; Iran is reportedly adding 23 new commemorations including the US-Israeli war and Khamenei's death. Iran designated Argentina's navy and air force as terrorist organisations, joined a key UN committee with 144 votes, and Pezeshkian sought COP31 compensation for wartime environmental damage.

This aircraft is from the Osprey family which is used to transport personnel, cargo and necessary equipment between coastal bases and aircraft carrier task forces.
